payload.abstract: The Hillel Yaffe Age Related Macular Degeneration (HYAMD) longitudinal dataset comprises of 1,560 Digital Fundus Images (DFIs) of 325 patients examined at the Hillel Yaffe Medical Center (Hadera, Israel, Helsinki approval number 0048-24-HYMC) providing follow-up data from 2021 to 2024. The AMD cohort includes 147 patients (73 males, 74 females) aged 54–94, while the control group comprises 190 diabetic retinopathy (DR) patients (111 males, 78 females) aged 24–92. DFIs in the AMD cohort either present with early, intermediate, or late-stage AMD, including neovascular AMD (NVAMD), visible geographic atrophy (GA), or presence of large drusen (LD). Diagnosis was based on a comprehensive clinical ophthalmic examination and supported by Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) scans, including OCT angiography. Non-AMD DFIs were taken from patients examined in the Retina clinic for DR and without a concurrent diagnosis of AMD. Diagnosis of DR was based on clinical examination, macular OCT, and in relevant cases fluorescein angiography, and widefield imaging. This dataset was developed for the validation of machine learning models intended to the task of AMD identification from single DFI. The annotations are gold-standard, meaning the AMD labels were determined based on a complete ophthalmic evaluation rather than solely on DFIs. The images were taken using a DRI OCT Triton (Topcon) camera, with a 45° field of view (FOV) and a resolution of 1960 × 1934 pixels. HYAMD is also, to the best of our knowledge, the first open access retinal dataset from an Israeli sample.

payload.short_description: The HYAMD dataset comprises 1,560 high-resolution fundus images from 325 patients, aimed at validating machine learning models for age-related macular degeneration (AMD) diagnosis.
payload.title: HYAMD High-Resolution Fundus Image Dataset for age related macular degeneration (AMD) Diagnosis
